### React to Shiny browser events

`watch_mascot_shiny()` connects a mascot to Shiny browser events
(`shiny:busy`, `shiny:idle`, `shiny:error`, and `shiny:disconnected`) as a
temporary overlay over whatever `update_mascot()` or `mascot()` last set on the
server:

```{r watch_mascot_shiny-call, echo = FALSE}
htmltools::tags$pre(htmltools::tags$code(paste0(
  'mascot::watch_mascot_shiny(\n',
  '  "helper",\n',
  '  map = list(busy = list(status = "Running analysis")),\n',
  '  delay = 1\n',
  ')'
)))
```

`delay` sets how many seconds Shiny must stay busy before showing `"busy"`, so
quick updates do not flicker. Passing `list()` for a key silences that event.
Because overlays live in the browser, `mascot_server_state()` continues to
report the last state set from R. Inside a Shiny module, pass the module's
local mascot id, the same as in `update_mascot()`.

```{r watch_mascot_shiny-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("watch_mascot_shiny", studio_character)
```
